about: Synthetic benchmark corpus for calibrating the decider's difficulty routing. Each item is a made-up user message with a hand-set level aligned to the five criteria of nanomuse.llm.decider.difficulty_question: 1 is a greeting, a yes or no question, or reading back one known fact; 2 is a short answer or one simple tool call; 3 is a few steps with two or three tool calls; 4 is multi-step work across several tools, with checking along the way; 5 is open-ended project work, many steps, long running. Levels 4 and 5 count as hard. No item is a real message from a real person.
